scope: A repository-owned U(1) gauge-matter action on R x T3 with the unbounded internal charge generator Q from K1358, defined on the smooth spacetime/K-finite common core, together with formal classical BRST, BV and boundary BFV algebra; not a source action, closed nonlinear KT resolution, global solution theorem or quantum physical quotient.

common_core.spacetime: M=R x T3 with Lorentzian product metric
common_core.charge_action: Q preserves H_Kfin and is bounded on every finite K-type summand, although unbounded on H_ps
common_core.field_policy: matter fields, variations, ghosts and antifields are finite charge sums on the algebraic core
common_core.closure_limit: no claim is made that the nonlinear equations preserve a completed graph domain globally in time

gauge_action.covariant_derivative: D_mu phi=partial_mu phi+i A_mu Q phi
gauge_action.local_transformation: phi maps to exp(i alpha Q) phi and A maps to A-d alpha
gauge_action.covariance_identity: D'_mu phi'=exp(i alpha Q) D_mu phi on the common core
gauge_action.action: integral[-1/4 F_mu_nu F^mu_nu + <D_mu phi,D^mu phi> - m^2||phi||^2 - lambda/2 ||phi||^4]
gauge_action.nontrivial_interaction: the current contains Im<phi,Q D_mu phi> and the seagull contains A_mu A^mu ||Q phi||^2
gauge_action.positive_energy: for m^2>=0 and lambda>=0 the classical core energy is the sum of electric, magnetic, covariant-gradient, mass and quartic nonnegative terms

brst_bv_bfv.brst_rules: sA=dc, s phi=i c Q phi, s c=0 and s bar(phi)=-i c bar(phi) Q
brst_bv_bfv.nilpotence: s^2=0 on the common core because Q commutes with itself, sc=0 and the odd ghost squares to zero
brst_bv_bfv.gauss_constraint: div E minus the Q-weighted matter charge density vanishes
brst_bv_bfv.classical_bv: the minimal BV antifield couplings A* dc + phi* i c Q phi + conjugate close the classical master equation formally on the core
brst_bv_bfv.boundary_bfv: the boundary charge is the ghost paired with the Gauss constraint and is nilpotent under the induced BFV bracket
brst_bv_bfv.full_G_boundary: the construction preserves the selected circle and its centralizer, not the full split G action on each fixed charge sector

claim_ceiling: The K1356 compact circle can replace K1346's uniform scalar charge by a genuinely nonuniform self-adjoint operator Q while retaining exact local gauge covariance, interacting current/seagull terms, positive classical energy and formal BRST/BV-BFV algebra on one dense invariant K-finite core. The unbounded charge makes completed-domain preservation a new obligation; source ownership, global nonlinear closure and positive physical Hilbert cohomology remain open.
